descriptionEn: Offered for sale: an apartment with an area of 59m², located on Rruga Pajazit Islami, near the New Mosque (Xhamia e Re), in Fushë Kosovë.
The apartment was built by Mendi, is located on the 7th floor and is sold fully furnished.
The space consists of a living room with kitchen, one bedroom, one bathroom, a storage room and a balcony enclosed with folding glass panels.
The furniture is new and very little used, while the kitchen is fully equipped by the brand Gorenje, with a 5-year warranty.
The complex has a private children's park, a school is about 3 minutes away, while markets and other necessary services are within convenient walking distance.
The price of the property is €55,500.
